services.name: Liberty Star Day Sail
services.desc: Get a look at beautiful Boston from the water - from the deck of a real tall ship! 1.5 Hours About Come out for a day sail adventure in Boston Harbor aboard our classic schooner, the Liberty Star. Get away from the hustle and bustle of the city streets and enjoy some quality time out on the water with unbeatable views of the city. Drinks are available onboard for purchase via cash, credit, or Apple Pay - our menu includes several beers brewed right here in South Boston! We also have red and white wine, vodka- and rum-based cocktails, soda, juice, and water available in addition to 1.5 Hour Boston Harbor Sail

services.name: Liberty Star Sunset Sail
services.desc: Enjoy a Boston Sunset Sail aboard a classic schooner. 2 Hours About If Boston is best seen from the water, then by far the best time to see it is during a sunset cruise on a classic Boston tall ship! We depart Fan Pier Marina and raise the sails, then it’s time to just chill out and relax. The Star can accommodate up to 39 passengers in addition to a crew of 3. Get away from the hustle and bustle of the city streets and enjoy some quality time out on the water with unbeatable views of the skyline sparkling in the twilight. Drinks are available onboard for purchase via cash, credit, 2 Hour Boston Harbor Sunset Sail

services.name: Liberty Star Harborfest Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Watch amazing fireworks from the deck of a real tall ship! About Celebrate Harborfest week with a BANG aboard the Liberty Star. We will be out on Boston Harbor from 8:30 to 10:30pm, with fireworks scheduled to begin at 9:15pm. Sit back and relax while you enjoy the amazing view of the celebration with a backdrop of the city lights. Our bar will be fully stocked locally-distilled spirits, Boston craft and national brews, wine, soda, juices, and water. We accept cash, credit cards, or Apple Pay on board. The Fine Print: Weather can have an impact on the view of the fireworks. In the event the Boston Harborfest Fireworks - THE BEST VIEW!

services.name: USS Constitution Turnaround Sail Aboard Liberty Star
services.desc: Celebrate America while sailing on a tall ship and viewing the USS Constitution as she transits Boston Harbor. 2.5 to 3 Hours About Celebrate America's birthday on Historic Boston Harbor with "Old Ironsides"! The USS Constitution will transit to Castle Island and fire a 21-gun salute at exactly 12 noon on the Fourth of July as she stretches her legs for her annual turnaround sail. Come aboard the Liberty Star as we sail alongside the Constitution for a once in a lifetime chance to see the oldest commissioned naval vessel still afloat celebrate our Nation's birth! Continental 4th of July Special Event

services.name: Liberty Star 4th of July Fireworks
services.desc: Enjoy a firework show for the 4th of July! A 4th of July tradition!

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: The Liberty Star is a beautiful 67’ wooden schooner commissioned in 1972 and completed in 1982 in Harrington, ME. Originally christened the Rachel B. Jackson after the shipwright’s grandmother, the Star is a replica of an 1890s coastal schooner with sturdy mahogany planking, oak frames, traditional pine and fir decking, and exotic wooden cabinetry recalling the workmanship of days gone by. The Star is available to charter for private groups for a minimum of 1.5 hours. The ship can accommodate up to 39 passengers in addition to its crew of three.
